name: Together
summary: Together AI is an inference and training cloud for open models. It offers serverless per-token APIs across chat, vision, image, audio, video and embeddings, plus provisioned throughput, dedicated endpoints, GPU clusters, sandboxes and fine-tuning. Teams typically start on serverless and move to dedicated capacity as volume grows.
facts: Serverless, provisioned throughput, dedicated inference, GPU clusters, fine-tuning, sandbox
About 32 serverless chat models plus image, video and audio models
Per 1M tokens serverless; hourly per GPU for dedicated (H100 $5.49/h on-demand)
LoRA and full fine-tuning, priced per 1M training tokens
goodFor: Trying many open models behind one API
Moving from serverless to dedicated GPUs on one vendor
watchOut: Catalog and prices change often; check per-model rates
Batch discounts are not published on the pricing page
